title: Generics Matrix
lede: A generic body is checked once and never re-checked: for each kind of type argument and each generic construct, does that one check hold, or does a rule reject the substitution at a stated site? Every cell cites the spec text that decides it, or is marked open with a counterexample program.
legend: Decided: one rule (or a consistent set) settles the verdict and the bound. Missing: no text decides it. Ambiguous: one passage, two readings with different verdicts. Conflict: two passages disagree. Select a cell for its rule, citation and counterexample.
